---
title: "Schedule"
output: html_document
---
  
```{r generate_calendar, eval = TRUE, echo=FALSE}
## load library
library(toastui)

## data frame with dates & topics
cal_data<-read.csv("calendar_data.csv")

## display calendar
calendar(cal_data, navigation = TRUE, defaultDate = Sys.Date()) %>%
  cal_month_options(
    startDayOfWeek  = 0, 
    workweek = TRUE
  )

# This dummy dataset shows you how things need to be formatted in order to produce a sensible calendar:
# cal_demo_data()
# The dumb thing is, if you open the csv in Excel, it'll automatically format the dates in a way that calendar() 
# does not recognize. It needs to be formatted as yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss. If the calendar isn't working, that's probably the # problem. Reformat the dates properly, save it again, and it should be fine.

```
